results.title: FBI-wanted American linked to human trafficking caught in Phuket
results.description: An American man wanted in the United States in connection with a human trafficking case was detained at a luxury villa in Phuket after the FBI asked Thai immigration police to locate him. The suspect, identified as 33 year old Ronald, was found at a villa in Chalong subdistrict, Mueang Phuket district, on November 13. … The story FBI-wanted American linked to human trafficking caught in Phuket as seen on Thaiger News.

results.title: Palestine marks 38th anniversary of statehood declaration
results.description: RAMALLAH: Today marks the 38th anniversary of the declaration of the State of Palestine, proclaimed by late Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat in Algiers on Nov 15, 1988, Palestine News and Info Agency (WAFA) reported.
